project_name.justification: The Claims, known as the Riley Creek Project, are located on the west side of Graham Island, Haida Gwaii in the north coast region of British Columbia.

company_name.justification: The Company is also pleased to announce it intends to change its name from "Spey Resources Corp." to "Armory Mining Corp.", effective on or about November 19, 2024.

ceo_buyer.justification: FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Nader Vatanchi CEO, Director

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Spey Resources Corp. ... has entered into a share exchange agreement ... with Antimony Assets Inc. ... to acquire 100% of the issued and outstanding common shares of Antimony... Antimony is a privately held arm's length party that holds an interest in two mineral claims... known as the Riley Creek Project

primary_commodity.justification: The project surrounds four separate gold-antimony occurrences. The named showings are described as: NEEDLES: - Gold, silver, antimony showing; SOL (GUMBO ZONE): - Gold, silver antimony showing; COURTE: - Antimony, gold silver, lead, zinc showing; RUMPLESTILTSKIN: - Gold showing.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Spey Resources Corp. Enters into Share Exchange Agreement with Antimony Assets and Announces Name Change' and details the acquisition of the Riley Creek Project.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Spey Resources Corp., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) and the consideration shares are priced in dollars ('$0.0675 per share'), implying Canadian Dollars.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is a share exchange agreement. No cash payment is mentioned as part of the consideration.
